say:2:1022124001:0.text: Hogan, you were too slow! Those barbarians stained my velvet robes!
say:2:1022124001:0.source_cn: 霍根，你和手下来得也太晚了！那些粗鲁的野蛮人都把我天鹅...

choice_prompt:3:1022124001.text: Hogan, you were too slow! Those barbarians stained my velvet robes!
choice_prompt:3:1022124001.source_cn: 霍根，你和手下来得也太晚了！那些粗鲁的野蛮人都把我天鹅绒的长袍弄脏了！

say:4:1022124002:0.text: You have a point. We should leave him here. With all the bandits around, he could've been killed. Even his gold tooth would've been taken.
say:4:1022124002:0.source_cn: 说的对，别管他了。反正这附近盗匪很多，他指不定就在哪被...
say:4:1022124002:0.male: You have a point. We should leave him here. With all the bandits around, he could've been killed. Even his gold tooth would've been taken.
say:4:1022124002:0.female: You have a point. We should leave him here. With all the bandits around, he could've been killed. Even his gold tooth would've been taken.

say:5:1022124003:0.text: Please! Don't leave me here! Take me back to Holistone!
say:5:1022124003:0.source_cn: 别别别！你们不能不管我！你们得送我回圣石镇啊！

say:6:1022124004:0.text: Didn't you say we were useless or something? You should have your own guards save you.
say:6:1022124004:0.source_cn: 我是废物，你还是指望自己的守卫吧。

say:7:1022124005:0.text: No! I was wrong... I was wrong, okay?! You're all great! Please... I want to return to the royal capital!
say:7:1022124005:0.source_cn: 不！我承认……我承认还不行吗！我承认你们很厉害！求求你...

say:8:1022124006:0.text: Tell me, General. What should I do?
say:8:1022124006:0.source_cn: 你说吧，将军，我该怎么办？

say:9:1022124007:0.text: Hogan... We know each other from the capital, Hogan! You've gotta save me!
say:9:1022124007:0.source_cn: 霍根……霍根你看在我们曾有一面之缘的份上，一定要保护我啊！

say:12:1022124008:0.text: I'll consider it if you stop causing trouble.
say:12:1022124008:0.source_cn: 如果你以后不再招惹他人，我可以考虑。

say:16:1022124010:0.text: Alright, I'll escort him back. You take your time, General.
say:16:1022124010:0.source_cn: 那好，我先带他回去了。将军你们慢慢走，不着急。

say:17:1022124011:0.text: Finally, some peace. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's head for Traveler's Light. I hope Lady Joseline has our tea ready.
say:17:1022124011:0.male: Finally, some peace. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's head for Traveler's Light. I hope Lady Joseline has our tea ready.
say:17:1022124011:0.female: Finally, some peace. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's head for Traveler's Light. I hope Lady Joseline has our tea ready.
